newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * U.S. Under Secretary of Defence Walter Slocombe, in Bucharest for a 24-hour visit, will meet Romanian leaders for talks on the country's prospects for first-wave admission to NATO and the growth of bilateral military ties.

* Romania will despatch top diplomats on shuttle missions to main Western capitals to seek support for Romania's bid for quick admission to NATO. Foreign ministry state secretary Lazar Comanescu left for Ankara on Thursday.

* Finance Minister Mircea Ciumara told news conference that the government will lower tax wages and give cash compensations to pensioners starting March to cushion January's fuel and electricity price hikes.
* Romanian-born piano player Radu Lupu has been nominated for Grammy award for best solo instrumental performance. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
